record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ALOLAN_MEOWTH and ALOLAN_PERSIAN declare ability PICKUP (passive NONE in the catalog). The strategy is shared; differences are stars and stats. Other units are not covered. The passive PICKUP (random item at fight start, other units) is a different mechanism with the same name and is not covered here.
record.summary: Single-target special damage (30/60/120/240 raw by caster stars: 30 for ALOLAN_MEOWTH, 60 for ALOLAN_PERSIAN) plus a steal, resolved BEFORE the damage. Steal branch A (target holds at least one item AND the caster holds fewer than 3): the first item in the target's item Set (insertion order, no choice) is removed from the target (items.delete plus removal of its stat bonuses; battle copy only) and passed to the caster's addItem. addItem can silently refuse (a synergy stone whose type the caster already has, EVIOLITE or RARE_CANDY without an evolution, RARE_CANDY while holding EVIOLITE, or an item the caster already holds): in those cases the item is simply lost from the target and not gained. Branch B (otherwise: target has no items, OR the caster already has 3 items even if the target has items): if the target has a player (a real player's side; undefined for PvE and ghost opponents) it loses min(its gold, caster stars) gold (1 for Meowth, 2 for Persian) and, if the caster has a player, that player gains the same amount (statistic counted); a ghost caster gives no gold even though the target still loses it. Then, independently, handleSpecialDamage(raw, SPECIAL, crit) is applied to the target: the steal happens even if the target is protected / skydiving / magicBounce (those only cancel the damage). Requested amounts: damage raw 30/60 and gold requested = caster stars; applied: damage after AP, crit, SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and later handleDamage steps; gold capped by the target's current gold.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target); item/gold are taken from that same target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: single target; no area, no cells read

effects.scaling: none: not affected by AP, crit or stars
effects.resolution: Requested: move the first item of the target's Set. Applied: removeItem deletes it from the target and removes its stat bonuses (only the battle entity, permanent = false, so the board copy keeps it for the next fight); the caster's addItem then adds it unless it returns early (3 items, same-type synergy stone, EVIOLITE / RARE_CANDY rules) or already holds that item (Set unchanged). When addItem refuses, the item is lost for this fight. Item gain effects and a synergy added by the item are applied on the caster by addItem. Which item is first depends on the Set order and is not chosen.

declaredRaw.note: amount = min(target player's gold, caster stars)

effects.scaling: none: not affected by AP or crit; uses the caster's stars (pokemon.stars), not the damage table
effects.resolution: Requested = caster stars (max(target.player.money)(pokemon.stars) = Math.min). Applied = same value unless the target's gold is lower. Only if target.player exists (not for PvE or ghost opponents). The target loses it via addMoney(-x, false, target); a ghost target origin makes addMoney return without change, but target.player is undefined for ghosts. The caster's player gains it via addMoney(x, true, caster) only if the caster has a player; if the caster is a ghost the gain is skipped. The money count statistic increases by the amount only when the caster has a player. Branch B also runs when the target has items but the caster holds 3.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); multiplied by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: Requested amount is the raw table value; applied damage is intermediate: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps. handleSpecialDamage returns takenDamage 0 and deals nothing when the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce (a magicBounce target may reflect damage to the caster unless the caster holds PROTECTIVE_PADS). The returned takenDamage is NOT read by this strategy, so item and gold theft do not depend on it. A POWER_LENS on the target retaliates against the caster (not enumerated further).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 3 (120) and 4 (240, also the fallback) are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP 90 and range 1 for both. Gold stolen = stars.

record.positionalConditions: No positional condition; the branch depends only on the target's item count, the caster's item count (< 3) and whether the target has a player.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the steal and the damage; successive casts take the next item of the target's Set, and the caster's item count grows (once at 3, branch B (gold) is used even if the target still has items).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30/60 (Meowth/Persian), gold 1/2 (stars), 1 item. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1), unless blocked (protect / skydiving / magicBounce). Item stolen only if the caster's addItem accepts it (the target loses it regardless). Gold stolen = min(target gold, stars), only against a real player's side. Steal is independent of damage, defense, shield or death.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multipliers were read
